Hi everyone

Hi everyone Instats is pleased to be offering a 2-day seminar on Foundations of Questionnaire Design, running January 29 and 31. Led by Professor Daniel Schnitzlein, this seminar provides an excellent opportunity to learn how to design effective and reliable questionnaires for surveys and research studies. Ideal for researchers and professionals, this course equips participants with the foundational knowledge needed to craft questions that yield high-quality, actionable data. Participants will explore key topics such as question formulation, response scaling, minimizing bias, and optimizing survey structure. With a strong emphasis on practical applications, the seminar ensures attendees gain the skills necessary to design questionnaires that enhance data validity and reliability in their own projects.

Sign up today to secure your spot and please feel free to share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit.

Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
